jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
As the Development Project Manager for a commercial Cortical Brain Interface, your primary responsibility is to lead the development team and oversee the project's execution from conception to completion. You will work closely with the management team, Development Manager, and Program Manager to ensure that project requirements are met on time and within budget. Your role involves:
• Managing project resources and budget allocation.
• Identifying, assessing, and mitigating project risks.
• Fostering cohesion and high performance within the project team.
• Organizing and leading weekly project team meetings to discuss progress, risks, and next steps.
• Supporting the Program Manager in facilitating monthly cross-functional and management team meetings.
• Providing materials and updates for interactive discussions on project progress, resource needs, and functional issues.
• Ensuring documentation is accurate and up-to-date, and generating regular reports on project status.

Overall... you will play a crucial role in driving the successful development and delivery of the Cortical Brain Interface, leveraging effective communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills to ensure project success.

Main Responsibilities:
• Define and execute the project plan, tasks, resources and budget
• Define and prioritize the development tasks, oversee and take part in the development tasks, as appropriate
• Lead planning, management of critical initiatives across the development team to achieve their performance schedule and cost targets
• Liaise with the Development Manager to manage the sub-contractors within the project
• Facilitate smooth interface and communication between the project team and other functions of the organization
• Ensure high quality delivery, while complying with procedures and regulations
• Support the development and deployment of best practices in the identification of risks to quality, to new product introduction, to production and initiate preventative steps in the project to mitigate these risks
• Support continuous improvement of yield, cost, quality and efficiency in the project and business
• Be able to travel from time to time as required by role and business
• A track record of project management execution In MedTech
• Bachelor degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Bio Medical or Industrial Engineering. Masters or PhD in a related field is highly desirable, or an equivalent combination of education and technical experience
• At least 8 years of experience in medical device industry and at least 5 years project management experience
• Track record of bringing new products from concept to commercialization
• Demonstrated management and leadership experience in working with cross functional geographically dispersed teams on complex projects
• Excellent written, interpersonal communication and presentation skills. Ability to effectively present information to other functions of the business.
• Prior experience working for a MedTech company whose products and processes are FDA regulated.
• A self-starter , able to deliver work required to advance the project with a minimal amount of direction.
• Excellent English Language Skills: Can understand with ease heard or read information. Can summarize information in a coherent presentation. Can express him/herself, fluently and precisely.
• Accountable to meet commitments by following through, with a sense of ownership, and taking personal responsibility for decisions, actions and failures.
• Able to prioritize and focus on the few critical objectives amongst numerous Project tasks and activities;

We are looking for someone who Is ready to proactively bring new ideas to the team, push boundaries and constantly look for innovation. At INBRAIN we believe on shared success and diverse ways of thinking, here you'll learn, grow and advance in an innovative culture

WHAT CAN WE OFFER TO YOU?
• A collaborative environment where innovative ideas flourish and teamwork drives us forward. At INBRAIN, we believe the power of collective intelligence is unique. You will be part of a team that thrives on open communication, knowledge sharing and mutual respect.
• Meaningful Work Impact: Our projects are not only exciting and challenging but also have a positive impact on the industry and society as a whole. You'll be part of a team that strives to create meaningful change.
• Cutting-Edge Technology Exposure: Joining us means immersing yourself in the latest technologies and innovative solutions. You'll have access to state-of-the-art tools and resources, fostering continuous learning and keeping your skills relevant in a rapidly evolving industry.
• Competitive salary (according to your experience/skills)
• Payflow & Flexflow
• Private Health Insurance (optional)
• Training bonus for professional development.
• 23 vacation days per year + 24th and 31st of December.
• Hybrid working modality.

At INBRAIN, we're not just offering a job - we're inviting you to be part of a transformative journey, Are you ready to transform lives? Join us

jobs_results.title: Project Manager (Flemish Market) - Permanent contract
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a Project Manager to join our team in Madrid!

Context of the position
• The Project Manager is integrated into the international team in Madrid. You would have to develop our partnership with a French company specializing in informing citizens about their social benefits and helping them to obtain these benefits. The company has successfully partnered with the home contracts comparison website Selectra to grow a common business in France, and then to duplicate it to other countries.
• You will join a team of two individuals under the direct supervision of the International Project Manager. Your main mission will be to grow the common business on the Belgium market.
• You will own yourself each and every step of the conversion funnel and be responsible for its growth:
• Development of the website https://mijntoeslagen.be/ (write new content, optimize the existing one, maintenance of the simulator) in order to generate qualified traffic ;
• Continuous improvement of... the monetization of the website ;
• Continuous improvement of the sales process, in collaboration with the call center sales team;
• Daily reporting of traffic, conversion and sales.

Outcomes to be accomplished

Project management and administration
• Local market research and compilation of public data to develop an understanding of the market
• Product management of the digital tool, and monitoring of its development by the technical team

Marketing strategy and content
• Creation of a sitemap, writing and updating and integration of articles
• SEO optimization and monetization of existing web content to make it more ergonomic and improve its referencing
• Definition and follow-up of a digital acquisition campaign, in conjunction with Selectra's specialized department: Google Adwords Search, Facebook Ads…
• Following and analyzing KPIs and use of tools such as Google Analytics or Google Search Console on a regular basis

Sales strategy (in collaboration with the Sales Manager and the Country Manager)
• Definition and monitoring of lead handling processes, and continuous improvement
• Performance monitoring and reporting, and continuous improvement

Profile

Dutch / Flemish is your mother tongue, French is a big plus, Spanish a small plus. You are also fluent in English.

You recognize yourself in the following:
• You have an interest in digital marketing best practices (SEO/SEA). Ideally, you have previous experience in content management and/or web marketing.

Fit competencies:
• At Selectra, we’re looking for efficient and organized people. We work in a fast-paced environment, where we expect you to move forward very quickly when defining and executing strategies.
• You are autonomous and proactive and always anticipate finding new and innovative approaches to all kinds of possible problems.
• You are objective-focused and give visibility to people around you about your progress.
• You are able to structure and process data and draw insightful conclusions.
• We expect you to be a team-player and to actively listen and understand your coworkers’ viewpoints.

Why Selectra?
• Madrid! You’ll be seduced by this city with a dreamy atmosphere and culture where everybody feels welcome.
• You’ll benefit from the flexibility and reactivity of a company with a start-up spirit (flat hierarchy, chill environment)
• A truly international company: we count more than 20 nationalities and make sure you can talk with everyone by offering free language classes!
• Company events: we work hard and love to celebrate once work is done! We organize monthly team events as well as 3 company-wide afterworks per year.
• You’ll have responsibilities within a dynamic team, here to train and assist you when needed
• We’re good at what we do: you’ll have the opportunity to work with the best SEO teams in Europe and be part of an international and multicultural team with more than 60 content officers working on SEO on a daily basis
• We care about your health and well being:
• preferential tariffs on your Gym subscription.
• Fresh fruits delivered every week
• But especially, a work environment where we never let unhealthy HR situations unattended.

Company overview

Selectra works hard to make the world cheaper, greener and simpler by offering home contracts comparison, subscription and management services. Initially targeting energy price comparison, Selectra extended its focus to broadband and mobile plans as well as to insurance and banking. In the long run, Selectra aims at becoming the spontaneous choice of consumers willing to gather all of their home contracts and recurring expenses into a single powerful management tool.

With over 1700 team members in 17 countries around the world, and over 409 millions visitors on its websites in 2022, Selectra is a leading European startup. It has been ranked #180 fastest-growing French startups by LesEchos in 2022 and has been listed on multiple occasions in the Financial Times ranking of Europe’s fastest-growing companies.

Working at Selectra is a stimulating experience as we try to only hire humble individuals having in common a real passion for their job as well as outstanding skills in their area of expertise. Age and experience don’t count as much as fast learning skills at Selectra, where young graduates often occupy top management positions. We strive to stay away from frequent work cultures’ flaws (useless meetings, bureaucracy, slowness...). We never leave unhealthy situations unattended. In a nutshell, we create the conditions for a serene work environment where being kind and helpful to each other comes naturally, which we believe is a condition to attract the best talents and achieve high performance.

Recruitment process
• HR interview
• Writing and SEO test
• Interview with the International Project Manager
• Interview with International Manager and- our partner
• Response to your application within 2 weeks maximum.

No consideration of gender, age, skin color, sexual orientation or other discriminatory reasons will interfere with the selection process at Selectra.

We inform you that the data concerning you are computerized and treated confidentially. Your data will be kept for up to three years after you have submitted your application. Only persons employed in the human resources department will be able to access your data for strictly internal purposes. You can access, correct or delete your data by contacting < email deleted for security reasons

jobs_results.title: Civil Design & Works Package Leader (F/M)
jobs_results.description:
Job Description Summary
Gris System Integration (GSI) is in charge of delivering turnkey high voltage substation project involving all technologies. These integrated solutions enable large scale electrification and integration of green, sustainable renewable energy with a great sense of purpose

Job Description

Within GSI South Europe, the Civil Work Leader is responsible for the valuation of Civil Engineering & Civil works activities during the tender phase (ITO), . Acting under the direction of the tender leader, he covers all fields of Civil Engineering: earthworks, drainage, foundation, building, building services, …

During project execution (OTR) he/she is in charge of delivering the civil works scope of projects reporting to the project director and in coordination with all other project functions..

He ensures that Safety, Quality, Costs and Schedule comply with contractual obligations, company policy and local regulation.

In link with Sourcing & Procurement, he has major... contributions to the management of the portfolio of suppliers & sub-contractor in his field.

He reports to the GSI Construction Regional lead and participate to the function’s objective definitions and their follow up.

Network & Links:
• Internal: Project Director, Project Managers, Project engineering director, Plant engineering, Internal Project Design entities, Project Controller, Site Manager, Commissioning Manager, Site Eng/Supervisors.
• External: Customer, Subcontractors/partners, staffing agencies.

Major Responsibilities:

Health and Safety
• Demonstrate EHS leadership and ensure Safety by Design & STOP WORK policies are implemented.
• Ensures application of GE GRID EHS Policy and procedures in all activities.

Quality
• Maintain/update tools, templates, design books to be used in civil design/works activities within projects.
• Participate to continuous improvement actions of Design & Construction phases .
• Treatment of Non Conformities and Lessons Learned

Skills / Qualifications:
• Appropriate qualification in Civil Engineering, degree level with around 10 years of work experience.
• Appropriate health and safety experience, training and qualifications in line with international standards for roles of this nature.
• Great interpersonal skills & ability to lead working teams in complex organizations across countries.
• Ability to communicate effectively, and to accurately and concisely report both verbally and in writing.
• Proficiency in ENGLISH mandatory / Additional European language a plus
• Good level in CAD tools (Autocad, Revit & BIM platforms)
• Good IT proficiency including collaborative platforms & tools.

Experience:
• Direct experience in designing and/or delivering civil works for HV substations or similar industrial projects, preferably in European countries.

Knowledge:
• Valuation methodology of civil design/works.
• Key applicable standards and specifications associated with the civil works applicable for countries in the region.
• Environmental legislation and good industry practice in relation to construction works.
• Civil Design Outsourcing
• Design-Build contracting strategies.

Other:
• Office-based position - will require frequent travelling to suppliers & project sites across the region.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

He reports to the GSI Construction Regional lead and participate to the function’s objective definitions and their follow up.

Network & Links:
• Internal: Project Director, Project Managers, Project engineering director, Plant engineering, Internal Project Design entities, Project Controller, Site Manager, Commissioning Manager, Site Eng/Supervisors.
• External: Customer, Subcontractors/partners, staffing agencies.

Major Responsibilities:

Health and Safety
• Demonstrate EHS leadership and ensure Safety by Design & STOP WORK policies are implemented.
• Ensures application of GE GRID EHS Policy and procedures in all activities.

Quality
• Maintain/update tools, templates, design books to be used in civil design/works activities within projects.
• Participate to continuous improvement actions of Design & Construction phases .
• Treatment of Non Conformities and Lessons Learned

Skills / Qualifications:
• Appropriate qualification in Civil Engineering, degree level with around 10 years of work experience.
• Appropriate health and safety experience, training and qualifications in line with international standards for roles of this nature.
• Great interpersonal skills & ability to lead working teams in complex organizations across countries.
• Ability to communicate effectively, and to accurately and concisely report both verbally and in writing.
• Proficiency in ENGLISH mandatory / Additional European language a plus
• Good level in CAD tools (Autocad, Revit & BIM platforms)
• Good IT proficiency including collaborative platforms & tools.

Experience:
• Direct experience in designing and/or delivering civil works for HV substations or similar industrial projects, preferably in European countries.

Knowledge:
• Valuation methodology of civil design/works.
• Key applicable standards and specifications associated with the civil works applicable for countries in the region.
• Environmental legislation and good industry practice in relation to construction works.
• Civil Design Outsourcing
• Design-Build contracting strategies.

Other:
• Office-based position - will require frequent travelling to suppliers & project sites across the region.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs_results.description: General Information As the product brand migration program manager you will have the opportunity to be part of the Product Marketing and Portfolio Management team of Grid Integration-. In this role, you will be responsible to coordinate across different workstreams and as a program manager you will look at the progress of the program by monitoring, tracking, and reporting strategic KPIs and ensuring the completion of our brand migration journey across all dimensions of our offering. You will have a key role in the transition to one Hitachi Energy brand across the board supporting the activities of Global Product Groups (GPGs) with a rebranding strategy, guidelines and resources in coordination with the Global Branding Team. By joining our team, you will be part of a diverse team, working closely to technology, strategy and communications. Your Responsibilities: Program ownership including monitoring, tracking, and reporting of the progress. Preparation of presentations and dashboards... targeting different stakeholders in the organization. Proactively engage discussions and communicate. Capacity to structure the program and governance according to changing needs. Identify synergies across the workstreams proposing improvements, as well as identifying gaps. Identify cross-GPG actions that will benefit ongoing GPG initiatives. Facilitate alignment amongst all levels of the organization by adopting formal and informal channels of communications. Living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your Background: Master level in engineering or marketing. An understanding of the manufacturing footprint of power systems will be ideal. Program Management skills, both inside and outside the team, leading virtual teams to achieve results in a global environment. Minimum 5 years’ experience (in local or global roles) in the energy market. Experience in managing complex projects, additional project management certification will be an advantage. Strategic thinking and proven experience in structuring and driving complex projects. Excellent influencing, communication and networking skills matured in an international, matrixed organization. Open minded and capable of innovative thinking. Ownership, self-sufficient & Initiative taker: willingness to move things forward by taking personal action. Fluent in English. Preferred location Spain (Madrid). Additional potential locations in Poland or Italy

jobs_results.title: Middle/Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs_results.description:
• What you will do
• Help PM leaders define the long term strategy and vision for the product, leveraging existing and new technologies to deliver features & value to our customers.
• Stay informed on the industry landscape to ensure that your product is competitive and differentiated in the marketplace.
• Help PM leaders plan and prioritize the product areas and give overall direction on features and requirements from conceptual stages through product lifecycles to meet operational, financial, and organizational objectives.
• Analyze customer feedback and usage metrics to identify key pain points
• Think big and continuously pitch new product ideas to grow product and core platform usage.
• Drive requirement definition, customer experience design, product roadmap and prioritization.
• Manage resource planning and product priority. Manage team efforts in deliverables, overseeing initiation, prioritization, and scoping projects or features in partnership with Engineering teams.
•... Identify and resolve issues that may impair the team's ability to meet strategic, financial, and/or technical goals
• Manage bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs, balance the business needs versus technical constraints, and maximize business benefit while building great customer experiences.
• Work with Redwood Partners to understand partners and their customer needs and influence adoption of your product by understanding challenges and identifying opportunities.
• Provide both inspiration and organizational leadership to various cross-functional teams in delivering high quality experiences to the users.
• Work with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand and improve product capabilities.
• Influence strategy and oversee multiple cross-functional teams defining, identifying, and tracking appropriate product or business metrics, both quantitative/qualitative for products/business ventures.
• Drive amazing work by defining detailed requirements via Program Increments, Epics & User stories, help scope & track Sprint level work to meet quarterly Objectives and Key Results, and ultimately Redwood’s yearly Rally Cry.
• Shape the culture model and hold teams accountable for creating a culture of belonging through inclusive, respectful, and equitable practices. Help teams and organizations communicate/collaborate effectively by setting a personal example.
• Must haves
• Background with Data Movement / Managed File Transfer (communications protocols like AS2, SFTP, FTP/S, OFTP2, encryption/decryption, communications security, Regulatory Compliance like PCI, GDPR, HIPAA, HITECH)
• Experience with Network technologies i.e. load balancers, firewalls, TCP Port usage and etc
• 1-2 years experience as a Product Owner/Product Manager.

AgileEngine is one of the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies in the US and a top-3 ranked dev shop according to Clutch. We create award-winning custom software solutions that help companies across 15+ industries change the lives of millions.

If you like a challenging environment where you’re working with the best and are encouraged to learn and experiment every day, there’s no better place — guaranteed!

jobs_results.title: IT Project Manager (US Timezone)
jobs_results.description:
* Assist in guiding stakeholders and implementation teams towards industry standard best practices and develop robust, enterprise-level applications.
• Ensure our Intelligent Automation standards and best practices are utilized across our client engagements.
• Ensure documentation of solutions within the team knowledge base
• Work with teams to evolve standards for solution, security, and the application environments.
• Stays current with emerging technology and trends

Solution Delivery:
• Work alongside Engagement team members to track various development groups and provide necessary updates on progress, blockers, and implementation progress using Agile methods.
• Provide oversight for both client engagements and internal strategic projects to ensure on-time delivery of in-scope items.
• Collaborate as needed between internal DTS groups and external department teams (such as Technical Support Engineering and Solution Consulting).
• Manage the transition of a given project to... production, internal support, while providing updates on project acceptance and closure.

Project Documentation:
• Maintain a central document repository for all projects, ensuring that the documents and file systems are consistent across projects.
• Provides training and resources to new staff members in the creation and submission of documentation.
• Reviews all documentation submitted to ensure that they clearly and comprehensively describe business processes and information.
• Analyzes source material and works with subject matter experts to determine how information should be written and structured for effective use.
• Ensures editorial standards and timeliness of documentation by regularly reviewing and updating existing documents.
• Works with support teams and clients to identify issues in documentation and to provide updates with the goals of providing support staff and clients with resources needed and to reduce resolution time and overall support call volume.
• Develop and maintain the master Style Guides and supporting document templates to ensure documentation consistency.
• Uses the appropriate computer applications to produce results and ensures effective use of these applications by utilizing advanced features of the software (heading styles, style sheets, etc.)
• Works with partner departments to keep documents up to date and properly centralized.
• Maintains awareness of active projects in terms of project stages to ensure that documentation keeps pace with project evolution.
• Ensures effective implementation of identified project documentation to improve department performance or to meet changing business needs.
• Investigates root causes of problems that arise from submitted documentation and recommends appropriate course of action to resolve the issues.
• Communicates regularly with appropriate department contacts to understand their needs as related to the documentation process.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS
• 5+ years of project management or technical service delivery/implementation with focus on change management and support lifecycles using Agile methods.
• 1+ years in business solutions analyst roles with a proven track record of business process design/workflow
• Experience in visual workflow representation (such as Visio, Figma, Balsamiq) is required.
• Awareness of technical implementation methodologies (Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), System Integrations, and/or Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
• Collaboration tools (Such as Teams, GitHub, RemedyForce) are required.
• Visualization tools (such as MS Visio, PowerPoint, Figma) are required.
• Project management tools familiarity (such as Microsoft Project, OnePlan, Smartsheet) is required.
• Proficient with Microsoft Office 365

Your application will include the following questions:

What's your expected monthly basic salary?

How many years' experience do you have as a Technical Project Coordinator?

How many years of project management experience do you have?
